test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 19 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Find a single discount percentage equivalent to successive discounts of 10%, 20% and 25%.
solution:
**Given data:**

Discount (d₁) = 10%

Discount (d2) = 20%

Discount (d3) = 25%

**Formula Used:**

Effective discount = d₁ + d₂ - d₁ × d₂ over 100

Where “d₁” and “d₂” are successive discounts offered.

**Calculation:**

Effective discount = 10 + 20 - 10 × 20 over 100 = 30 - 2 = 28

Final discount = 28 + 25 - 25 × 28over 100 = 53 - 7 = 46

∴ **The final effective discount is 46%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** Let the initial price be 100.

Price after 1st discount = 100 - 10 = Rs 90

Price after 2nd discount = 90 - 20 over 100 × 90 = 90 - 18 = 72

Price after 3rd discount = 72 - 25 over 100 × 72 = 72 - 18 = 54

Effective discount = 100 - 54 = 46%

∴ **The effective discount is 46%.**
